label: Church Admin Scheduled Follow-ups
info: Calls Church Admin's protected scheduled-follow-up endpoint every five minutes. Configure CHURCHADMIN_CRON_SECRET in the Node-RED environment before enabling this flow.

name: Setup required
info:
1. Add CHURCHADMIN_CRON_SECRET to the Node-RED environment. Its value must match CRON_SECRET in the Church Admin production environment.
2. Do not put the secret in the URL or directly in this flow.
3. Disable the Vercel scheduled-follow-up cron before enabling this scheduler, so two schedulers cannot overlap.
4. The manual trigger processes real due follow-ups; it is not a dry run.
5. The endpoint processes at most 10 due messages per invocation. A later run picks up the remainder.
